# Purpose
This file defines the metric metadata for the QUIC subsystem. It contains a generated `fd_metrics_meta_t` table named `FD_METRICS_QUIC` that lists counters, gauges, and histogram metrics used to track packet handling, connection state, handshake activity, frame processing, and error conditions.
